cachePolicy: Served by the Function as private, no-store so disabled apps cannot stay cached as enabled.

apps.summary: Smallest tool plus interactive UI round trip for the current server time.
apps.samplePrompt: Show me the current server time using the interactive app.
apps.safetyNote: Returns the current server clock. No user data is stored.
apps.alt: Get Time app showing the current server time and a refresh button

apps.summary: Adjust a synthetic seed-stage budget with charts and recalculation.
apps.samplePrompt: Create a $1 million seed-stage budget I can adjust interactively.
apps.safetyNote: Synthetic demo data. Numeric ranges and payload size are clamped.
apps.alt: Budget allocator donut chart with category sliders

apps.summary: Explore a dense interactive customer-retention heatmap.
apps.samplePrompt: Show me an interactive customer-retention cohort heatmap.
apps.alt: Cohort retention heatmap with rows of signup months

apps.summary: Filter synthetic customers by revenue and engagement.
apps.samplePrompt: Let me explore customers by revenue and engagement.
apps.safetyNote: Fixed synthetic dataset. Filters are bounded.
apps.alt: Scatter chart of synthetic customers by segment

apps.summary: Compare synthetic SaaS growth plans over stateless tools.
apps.samplePrompt: Compare a bootstrapped plan with a venture-funded growth plan.
apps.safetyNote: Synthetic financial scenarios. Scenario count and numeric inputs are clamped.
apps.alt: Scenario modeler with projection chart and sliders
